notes: Manāḥa, Ḥarāz highlands, north-west Yemen. ATTESTED, NOT YET DESCRIBED HERE. A published description exists and is named in `sources`; its phonology has not been read into this spec. The grapheme table is inherited from the parent and is a placeholder, NOT a claim about this variety — no reflex below has been checked against the source. The entry exists so the lect has a code and resolves to something usable rather than to nothing; `quality` is `stub` for exactly that reason. Replace the inherited table with cited reflexes before treating any reading here as this variety's. Watson & Asiri (2007) cite it for pre-pausal devoicing accompanied by glottalisation; that is a phrase-final gradient process and belongs in allophony rather than a grapheme table, so it is recorded here and not encoded.
